mapper.select: SELECT task_code, task_name, enabled, datasource_key, sql_resource, metadata_json, metadata_version FROM int_reference_task ORDER BY task_code
SELECT task_code, task_name, enabled, datasource_key, sql_resource, metadata_json, metadata_version FROM int_reference_task WHERE task_code = #{taskCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO int_reference_task (task_code, task_name, enabled, datasource_key, sql_resource, metadata_json, metadata_version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{taskCode}, #{taskName}, #{enabled}, #{datasourceKey}, #{sqlResource}, #{metadataJson}, #{metadataVersion}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE int_reference_task SET task_name = #{row.taskName}, enabled = #{row.enabled}, datasource_key = #{row.datasourceKey}, sql_resource = #{row.sqlResource}, metadata_json = #{row.metadataJson}, metadata_version = #{row.metadataVersion}, update_time = NOW() WHERE task_code = #{row.taskCode} AND metadata_version = #{expectedVersion}
